spec: DESIGN v2.3 §3.7; LOOKS.md specification row (47631ed); scripts/34_calibration_fit.py
outcome: hit@1 of the V2 top reportable R1 term (zavg_BEF, K=25) against T(g), primary circularity rule

standardised.formula: p = expit(w[0] + sum_j w[j+1] * (x_j - mu_j) / sd_j)

covariate_definitions.zmean: mean zavg_BEF over the K=25 full-data neighbours N(g) (raw)
covariate_definitions.cov_pct: fraction of N(g) in the release's annotated background (>=1 non-generic V2 BP/MF term), as a mid-rank percentile (0-1) among all scorable genes in that release
covariate_definitions.size_pct: log size of the V2 top reportable term (annotated scorable genes, release in use), as a mid-rank percentile (0-1) against the base top-term log sizes of all scorable genes in that release
covariate_definitions.family: module family of the top term (config/term_families.tsv; first match wins; else other)

family_rule: families with >= 30 H genes get p_cal; others ('rare' dummy in the fit) get no p_cal

support.rule: all four continuous covariates within H 5th-95th percentiles and family kept -> p_cal; below the 5th percentile only on zmean and/or R (others in support) -> boundary p_cal as an upper bound (not tiered; summed separately); anything else -> no p_cal

sigma_pcal_ci: 2,000 cluster-bootstrap refits of this model on H (seed 0), percentile CI -- computed at M6
